dict.string: Multi-workspace IDE shell for AI coding agents
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to control other apps with AppleScript. Burrow does not send these commands itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to use your camera. Burrow does not use the camera itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to use your microphone. Burrow does not record audio itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to record your system's audio. Burrow does not record audio itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to use Bluetooth. Burrow does not use Bluetooth itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to read your calendars. Burrow does not read them itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to read your contacts. Burrow does not read them itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to know your location. Burrow does not track location itself.
A program running in a Burrow terminal wants to access your photo library. Burrow does not read your photos itself.
Burrow and the programs you run in its terminals use this to find and connect to devices on your local network.
